title: EvoX
description: A distributed GPU-accelerated evolutionary computation framework compatible with PyTorch.

title: EvoGit
description: A decentralized multi-agent framework that reimagines software development as a collaborative, evolutionary process.

title: EvoGP
description: A fully GPU-accelerated Tree-based Genetic Programming (TGP) framework built on PyTorch.

title: EvoRL
description: A fully GPU-accelerated framework for Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning.

title: EvoMO
description: A GPU-accelerated library for evolutionary multiobjective optimization (EMO) via advanced tensorization.

title: TensorNEAT
description: A JAX-based library for NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) algorithms.

title: MetaDE
description: An advanced evolutionary framework that dynamically optimizes the strategies and hyperparameters of Differential Evolution.

title: EvoXBench
description: A platform offering instant benchmarking of evolutionary multi-objective optimization (EMO) algorithms in neural architecture search (NAS).

title: iStratDE
description: A GPU-accelerated Differential Evolution framework that enhances performance through individual-level strategy diversity.

title: EvoGO
description: A fully data-driven framework for black-box optimization, replacing manual heuristic operators by learning search behaviors from historical data

title: EvoNAS
description: A framework for neural architecture search, implemented with PyTorch. It supports supernet training, evolutionary multi-objective optimization, and seamless integration with modern computer vision training pipelines.

title: EvoCmo
description: A fully tensorized, GPU-accelerated multi-population evolutionary algorithm for efficiently solving constrained multi-objective optimization problems (CMOPs).
